claims.quote: Pathogenic variation in GAP activity toward RAGs 1 (GATOR1) complex genes (i.e., DEPDC5, NPRL2 and NPRL3) mainly result in focal epilepsies.
They are associated with high rates of sudden unexpected death in epilepsy and malformations of cortical development (MCD), where "two-hits" in GATOR1-related pathways are also found in MCDs.
